Which statement about solids, liquids or gases is correct?
A
Liquids are easy to compress.
B
Solids are easy to compress.
C
Gases expand to fill their container.
D
Liquids expand to fill their container.

options.label: C
options.text: Gases expand to fill their container.

options.label: D
options.text: Liquids expand to fill their container.
